approval.instruction: "Do the rest", sent with a new Gemini key after the Turkish get-up and assault bike were released, where the owner had said "it's ok if it's not perfect but I've been trying to release this for ages".
approval.context: The owner asked for the exercises without art to be generated in the house style with their Gemini key. They had seen this set as a contact sheet earlier in the session, then asked for the remaining sets to be finished and released, knowing the findings below.

findings: The head of frames 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 was edited down into the water in one image edit each (only the head and neck); frame 3 keeps the head up for the breath.
From the side, the two arms' beats look alike: frames 1 and 4, and 2 and 5, differ mainly in which arm is nearer.
The water is one thin line; there is no pool.
The card picture is cut from frame 2 with the water line removed (docs/exercise-art/cutout-sources/swimming.json); one pixel-sized speck remains where the line touches the toes.
No contacts or anchors were measured.

provenance.method: gemini-3-pro-image through scripts/art/gemini-image.py, with the canonical athlete attached to every generation. Frame 1 is a master and frames 2-6 are edits from the nearest beat. The head of frames 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 was then edited down into the water, one edit each, asking for nothing else to change. Every frame is kept at the 1264 x 848 it came back at. Nothing was redrawn by hand.
